agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix e0e0bf451e26 on top of intro a0e2148bbf9f via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The code path added in commit a0e2148 for reducing calls via FeedbackCell shared-function-info only checks `shared.has_value()` before inlining, but omits the `IsClassConstructor(shared->kind())` guard that the rest of the call-reduction infrastructure applies when handling class constructors. The one-day gap between the introducing commit (May 26) and the fix (May 27) reflects rapid identification during fuzz/correctness testing.
